entities.name: Great's North Sea Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Great's North Sea Empire, a political institution in Denmark during Viking Age Denmark (936–1042). Grew from Great Heathen Army and Danish Viking Raids & the Danelaw. Led to the emergence of Harald Bluetooth raises the Jelling Stone, Christianising Denmark and Cnut the Great rules the North Sea Empire — England, Denmark, and Norway.
